description.value: Uno Gelato is a Vancouver artisan gelateria making small-batch, farm-to-cone gelato and sorbetto fresh daily from natural local ingredients including Vancouver Island sea salt and Avalon Dairy milk. The shop rotates a wide selection of seasonal flavours alongside year-round favourites, and also offers gelato-making classes and event cart services across the Lower Mainland. Located at Stamp's Landing on False Creek, it's a notable stop along Vancouver's waterfront cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (30 spaces) at 14m; stands (40 spaces) at 17m; stands (16 spaces) at 29m; stands (16 spaces) at 33m; stands (4 spaces) at 78m. Total: 106 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Uno Gelato is an active artisan gelato business with a rich product offering, delivery service, and classes — clearly open. Vegan and gluten-friendly options are explicitly stated on the front page and menu ('Vegan Options available', 'Gluten Friendly', sorbetto always vegan, GF cones listed). Takeout is confirmed by the in-store cup/cone/pint format described throughout. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and most amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website references a 'Kitsilano location' for classes and mentions milkshakes at 'Kitsilano & Vancouver Convention Centre', suggesting multiple locations exist. The Locations subpage was not fetched, so it is unconfirmed whether 601 Stamps Landing is a current active retail storefront or a secondary/former location.
OSM tags show payment:cash=no (no cash accepted) and Bitcoin/Lightning payments accepted — unusual for a food business; may be worth flagging for visitors who carry only cash.
Website copyright reads '© 2020' which may indicate the site has not been recently updated, though product listings and delivery info appear current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible artisan gelato shop on a popular Vancouver waterfront cycling route with confirmed vegan and gluten-friendly options. Clear value to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website front page states 'Gluten Friendly' and 'Vegan Options available'; sorbetto line is described as always vegan; gluten-free cones listed on menu; specific vegan-labelled products (e.g. 'Fior di Latte (Vegan)') in online shop

wow_evidence: small-batch, farm-to-cone gelato... natural local ingredients... Located at Stamp's Landing on False Creek
